about: Every tunable limit and default in g1-lab, the model included. Change a value here and nothing else; .env holds only what is private to one machine (the token, the robot's address and key). 'source' says where the number came from: robot (a fact of the hardware or SDK), user (your decision), gpt-policy (copied from the reference repo), measured (checked by running it), repo (in the repo before the agent work), unitree (taken from Unitree's own repos: unitree_mujoco), guess (chosen without evidence: review these first). Print this table with: g1 limits

control_dt_s.note: the control tick: arm_sdk is published at 50 Hz

chain_pause_s.note: a tools task holds this long between chained tools

camera_timeout_s.note: longest wait for the first head camera frame (WebRTC on the robot, shared memory with --sim)

camera_poll_hz.note: --sim: how often the twin's shared-memory camera is read for a new frame

view_port.note: --view: the head camera at http://127.0.0.1:<port> (a free port when this one is taken)

view_width_px.note: --view: frames are downscaled to this width for the browser

view_jpeg_quality.note: --view: JPEG quality of the browser stream

view_fps.note: --view: most frames a second sent to the browser

png_compress_level.note: zlib level of the step PNGs in a run record (3: about 40-80 ms at 720p, on the writer thread)

record_step_s.note: a step record (frame + joints) is closed this often while a tool runs

base_vx_max.note: hard ceiling on forward base speed; Unitree's high-level examples cap at 0.3

base_vy_max.note: hard ceiling on sideways base speed; never tested on the robot

base_vyaw_max.note: hard ceiling on base turn rate; never tested on the robot

walk_speed.note: speed move and walk_forward translate at; must stay under base_vx_max

side_speed.note: speed move sidesteps at; must stay under base_vy_max; never run on the robot

turn_rate.note: rate move and turn rotate at; must stay under base_vyaw_max

min_segment_s.note: shortest base segment, so a held waist is never recentred faster than this

joint_margin_rad.note: how far inside the joint limits a measured or commanded angle must stay

command_vel_max.note: fastest the commanded joint angle may change between ticks

arm_sdk_kp.note: stiffness sent with every arm_sdk command (Action.kp); arms sag under gravity at this gain

arm_sdk_kd.note: damping sent with every arm_sdk command (Action.kd)

max_violations.note: a sim run stops after this many monitor violations

joint_moved_rad.note: a joint whose command or measurement spans more than this counts as moved in reports and dry runs

max_printed_violations.note: limit violations listed in a report or a dry run's reply (all are counted)

move_dx_max_m.note: furthest forward or back one move (or walk_forward) may go; you asked for room-crossing moves

move_dy_max_m.note: furthest sideways one move may go

move_dyaw_max_deg.note: largest turn in one move (or turn)

look_yaw_max_deg.note: largest waist turn of look: waist_yaw is limited to 150 deg, less the joint margin; far enough to look back over a shoulder

look_seconds_default.note: look: waist turn time when none is given

point_down_deg_max.note: point: steepest aim below horizontal (the arm then clears the thigh)

point_down_deg_default.note: point: aim when none is given (an object a few metres away on the floor)

point_sag_deg.note: point: how far a level straight right arm sags at arm_sdk's gains (twin, 2026-10-20; check on the robot), scaled by cos(down_deg) and aimed above

point_rise_s_min.note: point: quickest raise or lower of the right arm

point_rise_s_default.note: point: raise and lower time when none is given

point_hold_s_default.note: point: hold when none is given

arm_path_seconds_min.note: shortest time for one arm_path waypoint

arm_path_seconds_max.note: longest time for one arm_path waypoint

arm_path_seconds_default.note: time for a waypoint that names none

tpose_hold_s_min.note: tpose: shortest hold (the longest is hold_seconds_max)

tpose_hold_s_default.note: tpose: hold when none is given

tpose_rise_s_default.note: tpose: raise and lower time when none is given

sixseven_reps_default.note: sixseven: swings per hand when none is given

sixseven_swing_s_default.note: sixseven: swing time when none is given

sixseven_settle_s_min.note: sixseven: fastest move to the palms-up pose

sixseven_settle_s_max.note: sixseven: slowest move to the palms-up pose

sixseven_settle_s_default.note: sixseven: time to the palms-up pose when none is given

sixseven_hold_s_min.note: sixseven: shortest hold before and after the swings

sixseven_hold_s_max.note: sixseven: longest hold before and after the swings

sixseven_hold_s_default.note: sixseven: hold when none is given

sixseven_lower_s.note: sixseven: the arms go back to the stand pose over this long at the end

hold_seconds_default.note: hold: wait when none is given

wave_hand_seconds.note: how long the arms stay with the onboard controller for WaveHand; time the real gesture and correct this

shake_hand_seconds.note: the same for ShakeHand; time the real gesture and correct this

gesture_seconds_max.note: longest the model may ask an onboard gesture to take

gesture_seconds_min.note: wave_hand and shake_hand: shortest time the arms are handed to the onboard gesture

gesture_ramp_s.note: weight ramp before and after an onboard gesture

sit_seconds.note: sit: how long the arms stay with the onboard controller while it sits (twin_sit_s plus the FSM delay and a settle); time the robot's sit

sit_seconds_min.note: sit: shortest wait for the onboard sit

sit_seconds_max.note: sit: longest wait for the onboard sit

sit_line_up_m.note: sit: stand this far in front of the seat's front edge, facing it, before turning around

sit_back_m.note: sit: back up this far after turning around, leaving the seat's edge about 0.1 m behind the heels (twin, 2026-10-20: it sits with the edge from 0.03 m under the heels to 0.25 m behind them; check on the robot)

say_max_chars.note: longest text one say may speak

speech_chars_per_s.note: how fast the onboard TTS speaks; say waits len(text)/this; time the real voice and correct this

say_min_s.note: shortest wait for a say, so a one-word text still lets the TTS start

say_pause_max_s.note: longest extra pause the model may ask for after speaking

tts_speaker_id.note: the SDK's TTS voice (TtsMaker speaker_id); note which voices exist once heard

bookend_ramp_s.note: takeover and handback: the arm_sdk weight ramp, holding the pose the arms are in

bookend_ramp_max_s.note: takeover and handback: longest weight ramp a chain may ask for

return_to_stand_s.note: safe return after Ctrl-C, --max-time or an error: the move to the stand pose

return_ramp_s.note: safe return: the weight fade to 0

return_released_s.note: safe return: the final hold at exactly weight 0

lowstate_timeout_s.note: longest wait for the first LowState after the link comes up

lowstate_settle_s.note: wait after the first LowState before the first pose is read

lowstate_poll_s.note: poll interval while waiting for LowState, at bring-up and in g1 status

release_s.note: weight 0 with zero gains is published this long at reset and teardown, so the onboard controller drops any stale arm_sdk takeover

base_send_period_s.note: LocoClient.Move is re-sent this often while a base velocity is held (the robot's Move is a 1 s dead-man)

fsm_enter_timeout_s.note: longest wait for the robot to report FSM 200 after SetFsmId(200)

fsm_poll_s.note: GetFsmId poll interval while waiting for FSM 200

gantry_damp_s.note: gantry: wait after Damp, at bring-up and at teardown

gantry_lock_stand_s.note: gantry: wait after SetFsmId(4) for the locked stand to finish before FSM 200 (the twin needs about 2.5 s)

sit_stand_timeout_s.note: teardown after a sit: longest wait for a standing FSM after SetFsmId(801); time the robot's stand-up

restore_fsm_s.note: standing: wait after restoring the FSM the run started in

status_probe_s.note: g1 status counts LowState and asks the FSM for this long

health_period_s.note: G1_VERBOSE=1: the health line is printed this often

twin_physics_dt_s.note: twin physics step (500 Hz PD); the walker runs every 10th, at 50 Hz like the robot's controller

twin_fsm_delay_s.note: twin: how long a SetFsmId takes before GetFsmId reports the new FSM; time the robot and correct this

twin_lock_stand_s.note: twin: FSM 4 (locked stand) moves every joint to the stand pose over this long

twin_mask_arms_out_rad.note: twin: the walker stops being shown a look's waist yaw as the arms leave rest, fully once a joint is this far out (2026-10-21: lower and an arm out tips it, the mask kept and it tips)

twin_sit_s.note: twin: FSM 3 (sit) lowers the legs to the seated pose over this long; time the robot's sit

twin_seated_fall_z_m.note: twin: while seated (FSM 3) the robot has fallen when the pelvis drops below this

twin_sit_kp.note: twin: leg and waist stiffness of the sit

twin_sit_kd.note: twin: leg and waist damping of the sit

twin_fall_z_m.note: twin: the robot has fallen when the pelvis drops below this; it then damps, like the robot's fall protection

twin_fall_tilt_deg.note: twin: the robot has fallen when the pelvis tilts past this

twin_band_kp.note: twin --mode gantry: stiffness of the rope holding the torso (slack while the robot stands)

twin_band_kd.note: twin --mode gantry: damping of that rope

twin_waist_kp.note: twin: the onboard controller's waist stiffness when arm_sdk does not own the waist

twin_waist_kd.note: twin: the onboard controller's waist damping

twin_waist_hold_s.note: twin: after a walk, the walker hands the waist back to arm_sdk over this long; switched at once, the torso wobbled

twin_arm_kp.note: twin: the onboard controller's arm stiffness at arm_sdk weight 0 (the same as Action.kp)

twin_arm_kd.note: twin: the onboard controller's arm damping (the same as Action.kd)

twin_vel_feedback.note: twin: gain on the velocity error fed back into the walker's command (GR00T alone walked 2.52 m of 3 m on this model); with it, 3.00 m and 3 deg

twin_vel_integral.note: twin: integral gain of that feedback; removes the steady bias (with 1.0: 2.98 m and 4 deg on a 3 m walk)

twin_walk_blend_s.note: twin: when a walk starts, the walker takes the waist from arm_sdk over this long

twin_domain.note: DDS domain of g1 twin (unitree_mujoco's DOMAIN_ID); the robot is on domain 0

twin_lowstate_hz.note: rate g1 twin publishes rt/lowstate at, as the robot does (Python on macOS reaches about 260)

twin_camera_fps.note: rate g1 twin renders the head camera at; the robot streams about 15 fps

twin_camera_height_px.note: --sim: head camera render height (a task's camera_size overrides it; the robot streams 720x1280)

twin_settle_s.note: twin: dropped onto its feet and let settle this long before t = 0

twin_start_z_m.note: twin: pelvis height it is dropped from at reset (it stands at about 0.78)

twin_rope_slack_m.note: twin gantry: the rope's slack below the standing torso, so the feet carry it in any stance

twin_rope_lateral.note: twin gantry: sideways rope stiffness and damping as a fraction of the vertical (twin_band_kp, twin_band_kd)

twin_walk_floor_margin.note: twin: a corrected walking command is kept this far above the walker's Balance threshold, so it never drops into Balance mid-walk

twin_vel_integral_max.note: twin: anti-windup clamp on the velocity feedback's integral (each axis; rad/s for yaw)

twin_vel_filter.note: twin: low-pass weight per 500 Hz physics step on the measured base velocity (time constant about 0.1 s)

twin_gesture_edge.note: twin stand-in gestures: the arm rises over this first fraction of the gesture and lowers over the last

twin_wave_amp_rad.note: twin stand-in WaveHand: amplitude of the hand's swing

twin_shake_amp_rad.note: twin stand-in ShakeHand: amplitude of the up-down shake

twin_volume.note: twin: the speaker volume GetVolume reports at start

twin_start_timeout_s.note: --sim: longest wait for the twin process to load the model and walker and start serving

twin_status_period_s.note: --sim with G1_VERBOSE=1: the twin's status line (pose, rates, real-time factor) every this many sim seconds

twin_summary_timeout_s.note: --sim: request timeout of the twin's Summary (did it fall, where the base really went) at the end of a run

sim_viewer_hold_s.note: in-process twin (tests) with a viewer: the window stays open this long after the run

max_decisions.note: model decisions per run, rejected replies included (gpt-policy uses 100)

step_timeout_s.note: longest wait for one decision before the run fails

max_time_s.note: longest a program may run before the runner stops it (raise it for search)

settle_min_s.note: shortest stand-still before a frame is taken, so StopMove has landed

settle_pos_tol_rad.note: settled when every commanded joint is this close to its command; tuned for their arm, sim arms reach 0.019

settle_vel_tol.note: settled when every commanded joint is slower than this

settle_samples.note: consecutive ticks inside both tolerances to count as settled

settle_timeout_s.note: give up waiting to settle, and report settled=false

frame_max_age_s.note: oldest camera frame a decision may be made on

frame_timeout_s.note: longest wait for a fresh frame before deciding without one

max_failures.note: consecutive missing frames that end the run

vlm_model.note: the Hugging Face model id the agent asks (was VLM_MODEL in .env); a suffix such as :deepinfra pins one of the router's providers. Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct is the verified fast fallback

reasoning_effort.note: sent as reasoning_effort: how long a reasoning model may think (default: leave it to the provider). Left to the provider, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash once thought 52 s on one decision; none answered in about 1 s. Dropped if the server rejects it

max_tokens.note: reply budget, reasoning included; 400 cut a reasoning model off before it answered (a decision used 446), the longest decision seen used 10468 (52 s), and the HF router refused 500000 (its ceiling was 393216). A runaway now ends as a cut-off reply, not a 60 s timeout

request_timeout_s.note: longest one HTTP request to the model may take

vlm_temperature.note: sampling temperature of every model request (0: the most likely reply)

image_width_px.note: frames are downscaled to this width before they are sent

jpeg_quality.note: JPEG quality of frames sent to the model (records stay lossless PNG)

live_image_window.note: observation images kept in the conversation; older turns keep their text

retry_max.note: retries when the model is overloaded

retry_delay_base_s.note: first retry delay; doubles each time

retry_jitter_s.note: up to this much random time is added to each retry delay

recovery_timeout_s.note: total time allowed for retries before the run fails

states_hz.note: rate the measured joint state is logged at (gpt-policy logs at 50)
